videos.title: Bosses of Mass Destruction Mod (1.16.5) | Minecraft Mod Showcase
Bosses Of Mass Destruction (1.21) | (Minecraft Mod Showcase)

human_notes._source: guide (2 transcribed showcases) + jar (kill advancements, c:bosses tag, loot tables, structures)
summoning: None of these bosses is simply found and fought — each needs a summon step, which is the real quest content

bosses_of_mass_destruction:soul_star drops from UNDEAD mobs at a small chance, is thrown like an eye of ender to locate the Lich Tower, and is then placed in the bosses_of_mass_destruction:chiseled_stone_altar on the tower's upper floor to summon entity:bosses_of_mass_destruction:lich
bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith_end_frame (Obsidian Altar) takes a vanilla ender eye to summon entity:bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith, in a rare structure on the edge of the End islands
bosses_of_mass_destruction:void_blossom_block is literally named the Void Blossom Boss Spawner
The Nether Gauntlet is found in a rare nether structure and is already present — no summon item
how_to_fight: entity:bosses_of_mass_destruction:gauntlet is immune everywhere except its EYE: the guide says you must destroy one of the four eye blocks in the arena and that only the eye in the middle of its hand takes damage. A pure damage-race quest description would be wrong
The Gauntlet blinds you and the blindness cannot be prevented — the guide's advice is to carry MILK to clear it
entity:bosses_of_mass_destruction:lich spawns phantoms continuously; the guide warns the phantom load, not the boss, is what eventually kills you
entity:bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith turns invincible at roughly a third health and spawns pillars you must break to restore its vulnerability, while its other attacks keep running
boss_order: entity:bosses_of_mass_destruction:lich — overworld, lich_tower structure; the usual first target
entity:bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith — END; its advancement's parent is minecraft:end/kill_dragon, so the mod itself places it after the Ender Dragon
prep: Obsidilith is explicitly post-Ender-Dragon by the mod's own advancement tree — do not gate anything before the dragon on it
Gauntlet is nether-tier; Lich and Void Blossom are overworld-tier
order: Each boss has a dedicated arena structure with its own chest loot table, so finding the structure is the real gate, not the fight
key_drops: bosses_of_mass_destruction:crystal_fruit and bosses_of_mass_destruction:void_thorn — Void Blossom drops
bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith_rune — Obsidilith (code drop, no loot table; it is the advancement icon). The guide adds that the kill leaves a monolith with a shulker box of loot on top
bosses_of_mass_destruction:gauntlet_blackstone — Gauntlet (code drop, no loot table; it is the advancement icon)
bosses_of_mass_destruction:soul_star — the Lich gate, and the one item worth an early collect-N quest since it comes from ordinary undead

Craftables worth rewarding: bosses_of_mass_destruction:earthdive_spear, :mob_ward (Staff of Suppression), :monolith_block (Blast Amplifier), :levitation_block (Table of Elevation), :charged_ender_pearl
traps: Gauntlet and Obsidilith ship NO loot table and NO spawn egg — a jar scan that only reads loot tables will wrongly conclude they are not real mobs. They are: both have minecraft:player_killed_entity advancements and both are in the c:bosses entity tag
Do not target bosses_of_mass_destruction:comet, :petal_blade, :soul_star, :spore_ball or :blue_fireball — projectiles
The nine 'downsparkle' ids in this namespace are NOT entities; they appear only inside structure data and a naive spawn-file scan mistakes them for mobs
